wind.fixed_hour_note: the field at 12:00 UTC stands for the day
wind.note: 10 m stress-equivalent wind: satellite scatterometers blended with ECMWF, an observation product, not a forecast

provenance.method: ensemble of 200 particles, RK2 hourly steps through daily surface currents interpolated linearly in time plus leeway x 10 m wind; random walk K=10 m2/s; 90% ellipse = covariance x chi2(2 dof, 0.90)
assumptions: release at 12:00 UTC on 2020-05-22, the time the daily means stand for
start points scattered with 1000 m standard deviation
each particle's leeway is the nominal x uniform[0.5, 1.5]
leeway is downwind only: no crosswind divergence, no offset term, a simplification of the operational leeway tables
a particle stops where it would enter a land cell of the current model
provenance.note: a planning and teaching aid, not an operational search-and-rescue product
